title: per-app config (the one thing that varies across the 5 apps)

design_components.description: OPTIONAL. Names of Figma components the design team uses to declare intent on a flow board. Omit this block entirely unless an app genuinely diverges — design-extractor applies the defaults below when it is absent, and an app config that does not mention design_components is the expected, normal case. Purely a hint either way: the classifier decides board nodes from geometry, text and connector degree, so an absent block, an absent key or an empty list is never a gap and never a note. A trailing * is a prefix wildcard; matching is case-insensitive. Present but empty ([]) means the same as absent: fall back to the default.

annotation.description: DEFAULT: ["Notes", "Note", "Annotation", "Comment", "tooltip*"] — used whenever this key is absent or empty. Components that carry notes/context. The note's own copy is usually in a child TEXT, so detection matches the component node, not the text.

decision.description: DEFAULT: [] — no such component exists today and the classifier does not need one; it identifies a branch from size, a trailing '?' and connector degree. Populate only if design introduces a dedicated component, which would then take priority over the inference.

lane.description: DEFAULT: [] — same rationale as decision; a lane banner is identified by being small, text-only and a sibling of screens.

testbuddy.description: maps logical data states → TestBuddy MCP agents/segments
